requirement: Bind active sources and resolve later amendments
acceptance_evidence: Record exact accepted Main/Manual and relevant consumer commits/trees; classify historical plans and reconcile source conflicts before dependent claims.
negative_control: Wrong-base or stale-authority substitution is detected.

requirement: Bind each scientific claim to its dependencies
acceptance_evidence: A missing premise holds only the dependent claim; conditional models and unrelated mappings retain their explicit scope.
negative_control: An unrelated missing geometry example cannot silently block a self-contained ratio benchmark.

requirement: Distinguish graph, cell completion and physical geometry
acceptance_evidence: Declare each cell dimension, generator, incidence and admission/model status; a Q4 graph alone does not authorize filled cells or a metric.
negative_control: Inject a higher-cell/metric claim without its construction and reject that claim.

acceptance_evidence: For declared chain complexes verify boundary-of-boundary; for declared chain-map folds verify commutation and retained inner-to-outer maps.
negative_control: Corrupt one orientation/incidence or claimed fold map and detect the broken identity.

acceptance_evidence: Use separate algorithms/derivations from shared frozen input data; reconstruct each measure from literal cells/weights.
negative_control: Different trace IDs backed by the same target formula do not establish independence.

requirement: Preserve support and avoid volume double-counting
acceptance_evidence: Declare overlap, quotient, repeated-visit and multiplicity policies; distinguish oriented boundary cancellation from unsigned occupancy.
negative_control: Duplicate shared support or delete occupied cells through flux cancellation and detect the error.

acceptance_evidence: Retain original admission/certificates, immutable events, inner scopes and directional coupling records through measure extraction.
negative_control: Merge different native identities through coincident projection coordinates and reject the promotion.

acceptance_evidence: All applicable PLAN section 5 fields resolve; not-applicable and unknown carry separate reasons and claim-specific statuses.
negative_control: Drop a required source, parameter origin, domain or map version and reject unsupported use.

acceptance_evidence: Keep native counts, length, area, three-volume and four-volume distinct; check allowed domains at every composition.
negative_control: Use a two-dimensional area as a three-dimensional boundary measure or compose incompatible domains and fail.

requirement: State what a projection preserves and loses
acceptance_evidence: Declare equivalence/injectivity and relevant reconstruction task; exact lossy projection is not automatically numerical error.
negative_control: Claim unique reconstruction from a many-to-one projection and require a counterexample or supporting restriction.

acceptance_evidence: Dependency graph retains source identities through map chains and reveals any target/evaluation dependency.
negative_control: Change an unbound upstream input or hide a fitted parameter and fail provenance validation.

acceptance_evidence: Under explicit metric assumptions reproduce four-volume a^4 and boundary three-measure 8a^3 from cells; scope is conventional verification.
negative_control: A wrong dimension, face count or metric weight changes the check result.

requirement: Reject coefficient determination by forced closure
acceptance_evidence: Compute independent C, A and radius reports; demonstrate that shared q gives zero Cr-2A for arbitrary q and is insufficient evidence.
negative_control: Substitute arbitrary q while preserving the identity; do not retain a positive coefficient-validation claim.

requirement: Compare the same object across declared levels
acceptance_evidence: Freeze refinement, estimator and comparison scope; distinguish certified bounds, observed trends and proven limits.
negative_control: Change object or refit estimator per level and reject a claimed convergence proof.

acceptance_evidence: Expose fixed axial boundary length 8r versus a Euclidean-circle report even when an area approximation improves.
negative_control: Require independent boundary/area convergence; numerical precision increases cannot be reported as repairing a metric mismatch.

acceptance_evidence: Declare which relabellings preserve measures and which reverse oriented outputs; do not infer isotropy from one symmetric fixture.
negative_control: Include an anisotropic or orientation-sensitive case that violates an unjustified invariance.

acceptance_evidence: Native generation and estimator choice exclude evaluation constants; exact symbolic comparison and numerical approximation remain typed.
negative_control: A reference read used to select native weights or refine the estimator invalidates a target-independent claim.

requirement: Keep bounds, uncertainty and unknown distinct
acceptance_evidence: Every applicable contribution has a type, unit, scope and provenance; deterministic bounds are not silently converted into standard deviations.
negative_control: Replace unknown by zero or bound by sigma without a distribution and reject the budget.

requirement: Preserve dependence and avoid double counting
acceptance_evidence: Use shared-source identities, valid PSD covariance and applicable cross-covariance; support singular PSD cases.
negative_control: Duplicate a calibration term or silently zero a covariance and detect the unsupported uncertainty statement.

acceptance_evidence: Retain J Sigma J-transpose as a diagnostic; justify adequacy or mark the standard-uncertainty claim partial.
negative_control: Small marginal uncertainties alone cannot certify adequate nonlinear propagation.

acceptance_evidence: With the supplied finite joint distribution reproduce the exact nonzero interval spread or report a correctly scoped unresolved nonlinear result.
negative_control: The historical complete result with zero uncertainty must not survive for that distribution.

acceptance_evidence: Use the supplied finite-support product oracle; account for nonlinear variance/mean or mark applicability incomplete.
negative_control: The historical severe underestimate cannot be certified merely because linear variance is nonzero.

acceptance_evidence: A genuinely linear common-offset cancellation and a proven constant-output case retain their correct exact result.
negative_control: A blanket prohibition on correlation, singular covariance or zero uncertainty fails this control.

acceptance_evidence: Propagate a stated joint law or higher moments; quantify numerical/integration/Monte Carlo convergence and output mean shifts where relevant.
negative_control: An unstated Gaussian/independent law or unstable simulation cannot produce a complete uncertainty claim.

acceptance_evidence: Establish required domains and uniform bounds/Lipschitz hypothesis before using b_g + L_g*b_f or a justified alternative.
negative_control: Violate the domain or regularity assumption and block the theorem application.

acceptance_evidence: Exact defining constants have no measurement uncertainty; actual realization/calibration inputs retain applicable uncertainty once.
negative_control: Add fictitious device uncertainty to a definition-only calculation or drop real calibration uncertainty and fail.

requirement: Handle zero domains and finite windows
acceptance_evidence: Check reciprocal/relative-error domains, finite-window rate meaning, endpoint phase, drift, missed cycles and temporal covariance where applicable.
negative_control: A denominator domain crossing zero cannot be forced into a finite symmetric interval.

requirement: Validate source units and rounding assumptions
acceptance_evidence: Preserve raw hashes; justify printed covariance-zero interpretation and nonzero rounding; distinguish numerical checks from source integrity.
negative_control: Numerically altered uncertainty must be tested independently of the raw-byte hash guard.

acceptance_evidence: Use admitted recurrent coupled lineages, compatible scope/window and directional phase/lag/RCD records; no universal seconds per cut.
negative_control: Replace typed relational records by scheduler indices or incompatible cadence counts and reject the mapping claim.

requirement: Execute an explicitly scoped time mapping
acceptance_evidence: Bind cycle-equivalent observation map and reference; preserve epoch/coordinate consistency and applicable uncertainty.
negative_control: A native event count relabelled seconds without an observation/calibration map is rejected.

acceptance_evidence: A predictive H/Cs result needs one law fixing relative gain independently of the target; otherwise report a concrete family/countermodels and missing premise.
negative_control: A calibrated gain fitted to H cannot pass as an independent H prediction; atomic-prediction status remains separate.

requirement: Bind artifacts to their own inputs
acceptance_evidence: Fixed model/calibration/exposure inputs produce stable prediction bytes under evaluation-only target changes; comparison binds prediction and target separately.
negative_control: Target-only change alters residual as expected while leaving the frozen prediction unchanged.

acceptance_evidence: Preserve the committed common prefix and fixed calibration; later dynamics alter the mapped observable when the predeclared claim entails it.
negative_control: Break response feedback and detect the lost predicted effect; symmetry-invariant controls remain allowed.

acceptance_evidence: Record prior H exposure/fitting; transition period is a derived transform and distinct from elapsed interval or independent test.
negative_control: Relabel known H as blind or count reciprocal period as a second independent validation and fail.

requirement: Preserve unrelated work and active references
acceptance_evidence: Main/Manual ownership, precise source links, skills, placements/chart and untouched fixtures survive; moved definitions have verified destinations.
negative_control: Stale references, silent source rewrites, placement changes or unsynced skill edits are detected.

requirement: Reproduce scoped results and detached patch
acceptance_evidence: Run applicable normal/optimized checks, independent oracles, required publications and patch replay; report each scope; ZIPs stay below 20 MB.
negative_control: Missing manifest coverage, nonreproducible patch, overstated scientific status or oversized ZIP fails handoff.
